lint_missed: Bonnet FIREPROOF does not show in any sim shot (front, front34), so it is either mapped off the visible bonnet or hidden under the spine.
Rear-deck FIREPROOF is orange on black and only a few pixels tall from the chase camera, so it doesn't count as a tail brand.
Nose crop: the black edging either side of the yellow spine ends in small orange hooks at the badge, so it reads as a leftover rather than a finished end.

Side shots: the yellow band starts with a hard vertical cut at the fender/door shut line under the F of FIREPROOF, and the yellow on the front fender sits higher than the door band, so the band reads as stepped there rather than running nose to tail.
fixes: The brand is missing from the front and nearly invisible from behind. The front and front34 shots show no FIREPROOF on the bonnet at all, only the yellow spine and the 451. From the chase camera, FIREPROOF is a small orange word on the black rear deck that cannot be read at 200 px. The brief asks for the brand to read from the front and from behind.

The black tail stops at the rear deck and haunches. The whole rear face, the bumper around the exhaust, is still plain orange, so from behind the car reads as orange with a black strip, not as a car that burns into black. The side shots sell the idea; the chase shot doesn't.
EMBERLINE / KILN WORKS / ASH & CO sit on the orange door right next to the white 451, crowding the number zone. The brief puts them on the black sills and haunch, grouped as a set under the headline.

lint_missed: The bonnet spine's black pinlines change angle over the lower nose crease and leave two stray black slivers above the light bar (front, nose crop).
The raked split reads as almost vertical from both side cameras, so the speed the brief wants from the rake is lost on the body.
The roof and engine-cover dissolve ends in orange while the side dissolve ends in black, so the two only disagree once they meet on the 3D car (chase, front34).
The charcoal ash pixels in the black tail cannot be seen in any sim shot, so the close-up layer the brief promises at 1 m is missing.
fixes: The orange-to-black split behind the door is close to vertical, not raked, and the pixel dissolve is one tight cluster jammed against the final F of FIREPROOF. Past that cluster the rear quarter is plain black with only the sill sponsors on it. Rake the split forward at the bottom and spread the pixels back over the black towards the tail. That gives the wordmark room and makes the transition the design, as on the Paul Miller and Trilateral cars.

The top does not burn the way the sides do. In the chase and front34 shots, the roof spine dissolves into orange on the engine cover and the haunch tops stay orange. So from behind the car reads as an orange deck over a black bumper, not a black tail. Carry the black and the dissolve onto the rear deck and haunch tops so the sides and top tell one story.
Below the bonnet FIREPROOF panel, the spine's black edge lines break into short slanted slivers on the lower nose above the light bar. Make them either run cleanly over that crease or stop at it.

lint_missed: At the lower door, the orange field's rear edge almost lines up with the door's rear shut line, so the edge hugs the seam instead of clearly crossing it (side_l and the beltline crop)
The black spine edging on the bonnet stops at the bonnet/bumper shut line and leaves short diagonal stubs below the FIREPROOF box (nose crop)
The small sill sponsors fight the silver side-skirt blade: the fin crowds ASH & CO, and EMBERLINE's first letters are lost at the front end of the sill (side_l)
fixes: The side burn reads as a short stepped staircase, not a raked line breaking into embers. Low on the door, the orange field ends in a near-vertical edge right on the door's rear shut line. Behind it the haunch and tail are plain black, with almost no loose orange or yellow pixels trailing towards the tail lights, and the charcoal ash pixels don't show in any shot. Rake the split clearly across the shut line and scatter thinning ember pixels over the black rear quarter.

Black and yellow pixel blocks start on the roof right at the windscreen header, well ahead of where the side burn starts (behind the door). From the front and front34 the roof looks noisy, and the car seems to catch fire in two places. Start the roof dissolve over the rear roof and engine cover, in line with the side rake.

Bonnet and nose: short black diagonal ticks sit below the yellow FIREPROOF box, and a stray black mark sits on the left bumper corner above the headlight. Both look like pieces of the spine edging cut off at the bonnet shut line. The yellow FIREPROOF box also reads like a stuck-on label rather than part of the spine. Run the spine edging cleanly into the box, or stop it clearly before the shut line. The black sill also starts at the door instead of running nose to tail as the brief says, so the front fender's lower edge is orange.

lint_missed: The tail FIREPROOF touches the red LED tail-light strip on the rear bumper, so the light hardware crowds the word.
The yellow spine's black crossbar at the front of the roof only reads as a cross shape once the texture is wrapped and seen from the front.
The charcoal ash pixels in the black tail cannot be seen in any sim shot, so the 1 m layer comes only from the sill sponsors and hazard hatching.
fixes: From behind, the tail FIREPROOF is small and pressed right under the red tail-light strip, and an orange ember pixel sits inside the word between FIRE and PROOF. It does not read in the chase thumbnail, so the brief's 'read from behind' is not met yet. Give the word clear black space below the light strip and keep the dissolve pixels out of it.

The orange-to-black split behind the door is close to vertical and only covers the rear haunch. In front34 and from the front the car still reads as orange and yellow and looks front-heavy, and the 50 m 'black tail on a rake' only shows in the side views. The split needs a visible rake and more black on the rear deck and haunch top to balance the bright nose.

Just above the windscreen, a black bar crosses the yellow roof spine (visible in front and front34) and reads as a stray cross. The two small orange slashes under the bonnet FIREPROOF panel look like scratches rather than embers.

This is the fifth round at 7, and the same thing holds it back each time: the front half. The tail now works at every distance: the black wedge, the pixel dissolve in three sizes, ash pixels on the wing, the yellow tail wordmark (rear34). The front is still v1. In front34 the bonnet is a flat orange field bigger than a door on each side of the spine, with only the 451 on it. In side_l and side_r the car from the front wheel to the door is flat yellow over flat orange. The brief promised lighter-orange flame tongues and raked hairlines on the door; in side_l they show only as faint blocks low on the door, and in side_r and front34 I can't see them at all. The nose hardware is new and good: black plate, bumper corners, hazard lip, yellow mirrors. But between the nose and the door there is still no second layer, so this is still his 'front is a bit boring' car. Give the front something you can actually see at 10 m. Note: the replay track map covers the nose, the right front fender and the windscreen in the top shot and the bonnet in rear34. The beltline crop shows only roof glass and the map, not the beltline. So I judged the bonnet and fenders from front34 and the side shots.

The sill sponsors break on both sides. Between ONDURA and GRIVANT a sponsor sits under the unpainted carbon side blade, so only fragments show: 'V IM' in front34, 'ul o' in side_r. ONDURA loses its O at the front of the left sill (front34 reads 'NDURA') and looks warped on the right (side_r reads like 'AMDURA'). On the right haunch, zentiq sits on orange dissolve pixels (side_r), so the cream letters lose contrast there. On the left (side_l) it sits cleanly on black.
lint_missed: A sill sponsor sits under the carbon side blade and shows as fragments on both sides (front34: 'V IM'; side_r: 'ul o').
ONDURA wraps the front end of the sill: its O is lost on the left (front34) and the word looks distorted on the right (side_r).
The right-haunch zentiq overlaps the orange dissolve pixels (side_r), unlike the left side, where it sits on black.

answers.note: The front now burns too, in black, yellow and orange pixels in three sizes. On the sides a second dissolve rises at the front of the door (from u 0.28, just behind the front arch) and breaks into the yellow band. On top, black pixels and yellow embers spread back over the bonnet beside the plate, and the bonnet corners are black. The duct ramp ahead of the windscreen (i004/i022, unmapped) is black with ember squares, and the nose's sides below the band are black. The front fender's side is a mesh of small islands where no pixel clears the near-tangent lint, so the fender is still plain yellow.

The sponsor under the carbon side blade is gone: the front sill field carries the hexmoor, ondura and telvio marks (u 0.405-0.48, clear of the sill's front end), and the ONDURA wordmark is dropped. zentiq is smaller and further forward (u 0.728) inside the black box the embers keep out of, on clean black on both sides.

fixes: Optional polish. The small sponsors are still thin next to his favourites. Getspeed and WRT carry fifteen to thirty marks; this car has, on each side, zentiq, GRIVANT and three tiny glyphs on the sill (side_r, front34), and that's all. The yellow mirrors, the wing endplates, the black bumper corners and the bonnet across from the 451 carry nothing (front34, top). The bonnet sponsors promised in the round-5 brief are gone now that the bonnet has burned black.

Optional polish. In the lower nose, the crash-structure opening left of centre and the blade ahead of the left front wheel show as flat orange inside the black bumper (crop-nose, front34). They read as base colour showing through, not as a deliberate accent. The brief calls for yellow intake blades, and the hazard lip and the yellow strokes beside them already set that language.

Optional polish. From above, the yellow spine with its black edges runs strongly from the engine cover to the windscreen, then stops dead. Nothing on the bonnet picks it up, so the roof and the bonnet read as two slightly different ideas (top, top-200). The front fender sides are also still plain yellow between the nose and the door (side_l, side_r). The builder's note says no pixel can be placed there under the lint rules, so that is not re-issued here. The fix that's still open is the spine echo.
lint_missed: Lower nose: the crash-structure opening and the blade ahead of the left front wheel show flat orange through the black bumper. Only the 3D shots show this (crop-nose, front34).
The yellow spine on the roof ends hard at the windscreen header, with nothing on the bonnet to answer it. Only the top shot shows this.

answers.note: More small roster marks: a grivant mark on each yellow mirror and the rigmount and norvane marks on the bonnet's left flank, across from the 451, besides the sill marks, grivant and zentiq. The wing endplates and bumper corners stay without marks: unmapped and curved, where a sponsor can't be placed.

Tried: by test colours in the UI car view, the strips over the crash-structure opening and the blades ahead of the front wheels (i024, i026, i032, i033, and i068, i075, i148, i153 for the other side) are now yellow. But in front34 the crash-structure opening and the blade ahead of the wheel still show the flat orange: those faces are some other unmapped island I couldn't find, with both sim previews used.

The spine's yellow core now runs on through the black nose plate to the lip, so the plate reads as the spine's black edges widening at the nose, and the bonnet and roof are one stripe from above (top).

fixes: Optional polish. The nose is now the busiest part of the car, and its emblem doesn't read. In crop-nose and front34 the flame mark, drawn in black on the yellow spine, looks like a black keyhole or blob, not a flame. It sits beside a hard, stepped black field on one bonnet half, the orange 451 field on the other half, yellow slashes on the bumper, the yellow intake square and the hazard lip. That's five ideas within half a metre. In front34-200 the nose blurs into black, yellow and orange confetti, while the side burn reads cleanly. Either make the flame mark big and clear enough to read as the Fireproof flame from the front camera, or drop it and let the yellow spine run plainly through the black plate.

Optional polish. The front fender side is still plain yellow from the black nose to the door shut line, above the front arch. It shows in side_l and side_r, and in the top shot along the fender tops. This is now the largest field on the car without a second layer, about the size of the door next to it. The builder's round-6 note says no pixel there clears the near-tangent lint. That isn't marked blocked, so I'm raising it again: anything visible at 10 m there would close the last gap between the burning front and the burning tail. A tonal tongue, the band's black edge thickening, or the hairlines carried forward would all do. If nothing the builder can draw clears the lint, take it to Nickolaj as a kit question.

Optional polish. The small sponsors are still thin next to Getspeed and WRT. Each side carries zentiq, GRIVANT and three tiny glyphs on the sill (side_r, front34). The mirror and bonnet marks from round 6 aren't legible in any shot (front34, top). The rear lip 'fireproof' is small and discreet, which is right now (rear34). Also, the crash-structure opening left of centre in the lower nose is still flat orange inside the black bumper (crop-nose, front34). It was answered skipped last round and is unchanged.
lint_missed: The flame mark on the nose plate is illegible on the curved nose in 3D. It reads as a black keyhole shape on the yellow spine (crop-nose, top).
The lower nose's crash-structure opening still shows flat base orange through the black bumper (crop-nose, front34).
The top surfaces of the rear haunches stay flat orange while the sides below them burn black (top, rear34). From above, the tail reads as orange more than black.

answers.note: This was a port onto the v2 library and kit, not a design round, so the flame mark on the nose plate stays as Nickolaj approved it. The nose is a little calmer now: the grille's uprights and side faces and the intakes' inner edges are black instead of flat orange (sim 20261020-185506, front34). Whether to drop the mark or make it bigger is his call when he re-approves the design.

Kit: the front fender's side is a mesh of small islands (front_fender_l i123, fender_slats_l i137/i130/i125/i122/i121, fender_nose_l i120, and the mirrored right-side parts). With the front burn line moved forward to u 0.0 (--set front_u=0.0), patterns.dissolve placed no cell at all on side_l ('front-char.side_l: places no cell on side_l'). At u 0.1, one 7 cm cell landed on the fender top above the arch and none on its side (flat-sets/ee81003bb5). Every cell there either doesn't show at least 85% whole on one island or can't be kept clear of the lint's edges. This is a kit question for Nickolaj: bigger or merged fender islands.

No sponsors added in this port round, so the approved set is kept. The other point in this fix, the crash-structure opening and the blade showing flat orange, is fixed. Test colours in baked front34 (baked-sets/7494a98c55) identified them as the kit's named parts grille_side_r, grille_upright_l/r and intake_edge_l/r. They are now painted black with the bumper, and sim 20261020-185506 front34 shows no orange left in the lower nose.

taste.where: side_l, side_r and crop-beltline: on the door, the yellow band meets the orange 451 field along a straight, bare line between the dissolve clusters (side_l from about the door's middle to its rear shut line, side_r ahead of the 451). There is no pinline or black edge there.
rear34: the yellow 'fireproof' on the wing reads 'fireproo'. Its last letter sits under the right swan-neck mount and doesn't show from the chase camera. It is whole in top.

fixes.text: On both doors, the yellow band and the orange 451 field meet along a straight, bare line wherever the dissolve clusters don't reach it. In side_l that's from the door's middle back to the rear shut line, and in side_r it's the run ahead of the 451. Everywhere else on the car the fields are edged: the roof spine has its black edges and the tail has the dissolve. Here the two colours just butt together, which is the 'stroke between the colours' he asked for on eva-unit01. The brief also calls for the yellow band to be edged in black. That edge needs to be an event along its whole length, visible in crop-beltline.

From the chase camera (rear34), the yellow 'fireproof' on the wing's top surface loses its last letter under the right swan-neck mount and reads 'fireproo'. In top it is whole. It's the car's only Fireproof mark, so it has to read whole from behind, clear of both mounts.

It sits beside the stepped black bonnet half, the orange 451 half, the yellow bumper slashes, the yellow intake square and the hazard lip. In front34-distance all of that blurs into confetti, while the side burn reads cleanly. Either make the flame read as the Fireproof flame from front34, or let the spine run plainly through the black plate. Also still thin: each side carries only zentiq, GRIVANT and three tiny sill glyphs, and the mirror and bonnet marks still don't read in any shot (front34, top). The lower nose's flat orange is gone, so that part is resolved.

crop-nose, front34: on the curved nose the flame mark on the yellow spine reads as a black keyhole shape, not a flame.

answers.note: The band's lower black edge was 0.585-0.6 v, about 5 px, and sat inside the door's crease (v ~0.59), where it read as the crease's shadow. It is now 0.572-0.615 v, about 14 px, across the crease, so it shows on both faces as a continuous black line under the yellow the whole length of the door on both sides. It stays 12 px clear of the side number zones (their tops at v 0.522 left, 0.531 right), so it isn't snapped or bent near the 451. Evidence: baked/side_l.png and baked/side_r.png, and crops final_door_l.png and final_door_r.png in the builder's scratchpad (side_l x 300-1300, y 440-680).

The wing's 'fireproof' moved from u 1.01 to 1.04 on the top view, towards the wing's trailing edge, where the right swan neck's upright no longer covers its last letter from the chase camera. Evidence: baked/rear34.png reads 'fireproof' whole between both mounts (crop final_wing.png, rear34 x 280-760, y 420-640), and baked/top.png shows it whole on the wing.

Only one fits: the quarter (i160/i053) is mapped at u 0.96-0.99, and a column of two failed sponsor_group's minimum sizes. The bonnet's rigmount and norvane marks went from 0.021 to 0.027 high and now show as marks in baked/top.png (crop final_bonnet.png). The mirror marks are unchanged, and the sill set is the approved one.
